channel.title: World
channel.description: The Washington Post World section provides information and analysis of breaking world news stories. In addition to our world news and video, Post World News offers discussions and blogs on major international news and economic issues.

item.title: See what it’s like to use a North Korean smartphone under Kim Jong Un
item.dc:creator: Michelle Lee
item.description: North Koreans are banking, getting makeup tutorials and using period trackers on their phones. But under Kim, these digital comforts are also tools of control.

item.title: Houthis claim attack on Saudi oil refinery as Iran war widens to Red Sea
item.dc:creator: Mohamad El Chamaa
item.description: The strikes by Yemen's Iran-backed Houthi rebels could add to the pressure on global oil markets on top of disruptions caused by the closure of the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Trump swings back toward diplomacy in escalating war with Iran
item.dc:creator: Michael Birnbaum
item.description: After threatening a “massive attack,” the president said his envoys were talking with Tehran but left open the possibility of a sharp military escalation.
